<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

 "brief": "## Problem\nClaims payments are delayed because third-party bank details cannot be verified before processing, leading to reissues and frustrated policyholders. This affects cash flow and reporting accuracy.\n\n## Who is affected\n- **Insurance carriers** who issue payments to third-party suppliers and cannot validate bank details ahead of time, causing bounced payments and rework [i:0810d33b7befd9dc][i:3a68dd3a6f3ff801][i:4d8a57c2f228cdb4].\n- **Policyholders** who experience delays in claims resolution due to payment reissuance [i:4d8a57c2f228cdb4][i:e9c7f9b651cb8ad6].\n- **Finance and reporting teams** whose reserves and supplier reporting are negatively impacted by the rework and delays [i:26f44575b6dac473][i:9bd19c6494c50ad9][i:61c8fd8956849053].\n\n## Evidence\n- The problem has been mentioned 22 times across 9 accounts [i:0810d33b7befd9dc][i:1a5ecfa9cdb48b37][i:3a68dd3a6f3ff801].\n- Mentions came through three routes: sales (7 mentions), support (12 mentions), and account management (3 mentions) [i:4d10f0a8fa0b09ff][i:4204829429da678e][i:61c8fd8956849053].\n- The combined Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of the affected accounts is £4,846,000.0 [i:03f272ecc7cd6170][i:4d8a57c2f228cdb4][i:61c8fd8956849053].\n- Two accounts have renewed in the last 90 days [i:c9e3db7d4874d791][i:e9937b8271f56bf2].\n- Pendleford Motor Mutual states, We’re seeing delays in claims payments because we can’t verify third-party bank details ahead of time — it’s causing reissues and unhappy policyholders [i:0810d33b7befd9dc].\n- Brantwick Commercial explains, when we send payments to third parties, the bank info isn’t verified ahead of time... payment detail checking isn’t happening before funds go out, so we’re stuck reissuing failed payments days later [i:5195e479ae636965].\n- Thistlecombe Mutual says, We’re struggling because we can’t verify third-party payee bank details before sending payments — it forces us to reissue failed payments days later, which delays claims resolution for policyholders [i:4d8a57c2f228cdb4].\n- Holloway Reach Underwriting reports, We’re running into delays because the payee account verification step isn’t happening before the payment is sent out, which causes rework and client frustration [i:a16c8653e17d2f9e].\n- Marrowgate Commercial notes, We’ve also noticed that payee account verification isn’t happening before funds are released — it’s causing unnecessary re-issuance delays and affecting our supplier timelines [i:61c8fd8956849053].\n- Ravensgill Insurance states, we can’t verify third-party bank info before paying — so payments bounce and we reissue days later [i:ea91ae3bee7a144d].\n\n## Why now\n- The issue is actively causing payment delays and rework, with multiple accounts reporting it through support and sales channels in recent months [i:0810d33b7befd9dc][i:4d8a57c2f228cdb4][i:61c8fd8956849053].\n- Two accounts, Marrowgate Commercial (renewal 2026-12-12) and Elderfold Home (renewal 2026-12-21), are approaching renewal, and the problem is affecting their operations [i:61c8fd8956849053][i:c9e3db7d4874d791].\n- Accounts are explicitly linking the inability to verify bank details to impacts on cash flow, reserves, and reporting accuracy, indicating a growing operational and financial urgency [i:26f44575b6dac473][i:9bd19c6494c50ad9][i:e9c7f9b651cb8ad6].",

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the quantitative claims against the fact sheet: 22 mentions across 9 accounts, route breakdown (7 sales / 12 support / 3 account management), £4,846,000 combined ARR, and 2 renewals in the last 90 days all match exactly. I verified each quoted account statement (Pendleford, Brantwick, Thistlecombe, Holloway Reach, Marrowgate, Ravensgill) against the cited insights and they are verbatim or clearly ellipsed excerpts, not paraphrases in quotation marks. The renewal dates cited for Marrowgate Commercial (2026-12-12) and Elderfold Home (2026-12-21) match the fact sheet, and the impacts on reserves/reporting are directly supported by cited quotes (e.g., Brantwick's 'messes up our reserves and reporting'). No uncited claims or contrary evidence found.", "verdict": "pass"}
